svg.title: program-search-loop
svg.desc: FunSearch program search: a user-written specification (evaluate function, optional solve skeleton and an initial function to evolve) seeds a programs database kept in islands; best-shot prompts of k sampled programs go to a pretrained LLM sampler, an evaluator runs and scores the new programs and writes correct ones back; the highest-scoring programs can be retrieved at any time. Generic labels only; no published values. Script-drawn schematic: layout, text and icons are generated by build.py as vector shapes (no bitmaps, no AI-generated icons).

g.text: half is periodically reset by cloning
the best program of a surviving island
evaluate() and skeleton run inside main()
